canary_acceptance.expectation: Every candidate, quote and normalized record must stay within the selected company, frozen source, batch blocks and allowed catalog. Other sources or batches do not prove coverage.
Balance-sheet observations use instant_2023-12-30 or instant_2022-12-31, not the annual flow periods. The balance sheet supplies two comparative columns, not three.
Cash and cash equivalents exclude the separately presented short-term investments; do not silently sum the two.
Preserve reported net current portion and noncurrent portion. Do not relabel their sum as principal or lease-inclusive debt. Unsupported exact metric mapping stays unresolved.

The FY2022 current-debt dash is zero in raw inline metadata, but that marker is absent from the delivered block. Missing numeric interpretation is a legitimate gap here; do not treat reviewer-only metadata as model-visible evidence.

USD common-stock carrying value, USD-per-share par value, issued shares, outstanding shares and treasury shares remain distinct. Millions scale does not apply to the par value. Do not substitute weighted-average shares from another table.
Retain both supported comparative columns or report actual omission; a prose statement that items were retained is not an extracted fact.
Source-correct candidate facts can remain unmapped. A numeric literal, alias or unit failure cannot be repaired by inserting held-out expected values.
Program-check pass, independent source-match and adoption remain separate; no automatic adoption.

cash_flow_followup_cautions: Fiscal flows use source dates 2023-01-01..2023-12-30, 2021-12-26..2022-12-31 and 2020-12-27..2021-12-25; the middle year is 53 weeks.

Capex appears as parenthesized outflow in the presented table, while its inline PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment concept is a positive payment magnitude. Preserve displayed sign first; any magnitude conversion needs an explicit rule and lineage.
Supplemental accrued-but-unpaid PPE is a noncash disclosure in batch 5. It cannot replace or be silently added to cash purchases in batch 4.

Cash at beginning/end is an instant fact even inside a flow statement. The current catalog lacks the 2021-12-25 and 2020-12-26 instant periods; report the gap rather than map those balances to annual durations.
Debt proceeds and repayment are cash-flow transactions, not closing debt balances.
The same source has original inline fixed-zero metadata for several dashes. Delivered table text alone does not expose that metadata.
